answer: Before an agent can bid, it must lock a refundable stake in a registry; one stake authorizes one active identity, and signed, independently checkable proof of double-spending triggers forfeiture. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund and immobilize a separate deposit for every fake account, risking loss rather than creating identities for free. This jetty weakens at its nadir if deposits are trivial, so marble-hard evidence and meaningful stakes are essential.
